name: Camp Meadowbrook
description_short: Weekly summer programs on The Meadowbrook School campus for children 3 to 12, each built around age appropriate, academically based activities. Little Adventurers serves the youngest campers and specialty camps run by the week.
refund_policy_summary: 90% refund until March 15 and 40% until April 15, each less a 10% processing fee, for accounts paid in full; deposits are non-refundable.
notes: 2026: programs ran June 8 to August 14. Most programs $375 to $495 a week; Little Adventurers needs at least 2 weeks. Early bird discounts in December and up to 10% sibling discount. Campers must be potty trained. Optional lunch program (price not posted) or bring lunch; bring a snack. No extended care in summer 2026. Financial aid awards up to $1,000, apply by April 15. Registration opens December 1. The FAQ gives ZIP 19001; the school's page and the Census geocoder give 19046.
